HSN_6307.source_note: Seeded from CGST ready reckoner 01.05.2022, Schedule I entry 224 - other made up textile articles, sale value not exceeding Rs 1000 per piece (2.5% CGST = 5% total). Figure supplied by the task specification. NOT independently verified against the CBIC portal: this build runs offline with no network access, so the notification text could not be re-read. The 2022 reckoner predates the 2025 rate revision and Notification 9/2025-Integrated Tax (Rate) was not cross-checked for this heading - confirm before any figure is relied on for invoicing.

HSN_63079091.source_note: Inherited from the seeded parent heading HSN_6307, of which 63079091 (textile face masks without a replaceable filter or mechanical parts) is a tariff item. No entry specific to 63079091 exists in the knowledge base, so the heading-level figure is applied and rate_scope is recorded as 'heading'. rate_confidence is deliberately set one step lower than the parent ('low') because the value is inherited rather than matched. Carries the same caveats as HSN_6307: supplied by the task specification, not independently verified offline, and predating the 2025 revision.
